profile.bio: Xi Wei is a PhD candidate in the Department of Urban Planning and Design at The University of Hong Kong. He received his master's degree in Urban Planning from Nanjing University in June 2024 and his bachelor's degree in Urban and Rural Planning from Nanjing University in June 2021. His research focuses on intercity mobility, X-minute cities, activity spaces, accessibility, and urban spatial restructuring.

researchAreas.title: Intercity mobility and regional integration
researchAreas.description: Understanding how daily cross-city movements reshape activity spaces, commuting systems, and regional urban networks.

researchAreas.title: Accessibility, activity space, and social equity
researchAreas.description: Measuring how people actually reach urban opportunities across neighborhoods, facilities, and transport environments.

researchAreas.title: X-minute cities and climate-adaptive communities
researchAreas.description: Evaluating community life circles, effective accessibility, and service provision under changing environmental conditions.
